scmomat_local.corpus: No upstream checkpoint or pretraining corpus; supplied development matrices only

interpretation: scMoMaT has no pretrained-checkpoint contamination, but this does not make it eligible for held-donor evaluation. Its cell representation consists of free C_cells parameters allocated for the cells supplied to the factorization. A held or held-back cell has no coordinate unless its data enter transductive training or new coordinates are optimized. Both does not meet the frozen held-back-query requirements. The method remains scientifically useful only for a future explicitly descriptive, nonpromotable development integration task.
remaining_blockers: Create a separate nonpromotable development-only latent-integration TaskSpec before any run; current sealed and RNA-conditioned ATAC tasks cannot schedule scMoMaT.
Exclude GSE289173 entirely. Do not include sealed features in a joint factorization or optimize sealed-cell coordinates.
Freeze exact repository source rather than assuming the post-release main commit is byte-equivalent to PyPI 0.2.2; record environment and source receipt.
Validate exact ordered same-nucleus IDs before treating GSE296875 modalities as parallel rows; represent GSE244832 aliquots as separate batches with None placeholders.

Freeze feature inventories, peak remapping, preprocessing, K, regularization, minibatch fraction, iterations, seeds, post-processing graph, and any descriptive clustering within the declared development population.
Do not use second-stage labels or marker retraining as representation evidence in the common lane; cells remain non-independent and donors remain the inferential unit.
Never load external whole-model torch objects. Export plain local factor arrays and hashes if the deferred task is activated.
Validate dense-memory requirements and modern Python/PyTorch L40S numerical behavior before scheduling even a development-only run.
